# cumba

**CUMBA** (Carbon Use Model for yield and Brix Assessment) is a daily
time-step crop model for **processing tomato**. Given daily weather and
an irrigation schedule, it computes thermal time, phenology and root
growth, a three-layer soil-water balance, carbon accumulation modulated
by heat / cold / water stress, and finally predicts **fresh-fruit yield
and Brix at harvest**.

The package exposes two top-level entry points:

- [`cumba_experiment()`](https://tomatoModelling.github.io/cumba_R_package/reference/cumba_experiment.md)
  — run the model on observed experiments using a user-supplied
  irrigation schedule (calibration mode).
- [`cumba_scenario()`](https://tomatoModelling.github.io/cumba_R_package/reference/cumba_scenario.md)
  — run the model in **deficit-irrigation scenario mode**, where
  irrigation is automatically triggered on phase-specific water-stress
  thresholds.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("tomatoModelling/cumba_R_package")
```

## A first run

``` r

library(cumba)

data(tomatoFoggia)

out <- cumba_experiment(
  weather       = tomatoFoggia$weather,
  param         = cumbaParameters,
  irrigation_df = tomatoFoggia$irrigation,
  estimateRad   = TRUE,
  estimateET0   = TRUE,
  fullOut       = FALSE
)

head(out)
```

# Package index

## Model runners

Top-level functions to run the CUMBA daily simulation

- [`cumba_experiment()`](https://tomatoModelling.github.io/cumba_R_package/reference/cumba_experiment.md)
  : CUMBA model — experiment runner
- [`cumba_scenario()`](https://tomatoModelling.github.io/cumba_R_package/reference/cumba_scenario.md)
  : CUMBA model — automatic irrigation scenario runner

## Data

Default parameters and example datasets

- [`cumbaParameters`](https://tomatoModelling.github.io/cumba_R_package/reference/cumbaParameters.md)
  : Model Parameters for Cumba
- [`tomatoFoggia`](https://tomatoModelling.github.io/cumba_R_package/reference/tomatoFoggia.md)
  : Tomato field trial data from Foggia (Italy)
